title: Why GenZ is going broke to look rich
description:

Showoff culture is silently draining the youth financially. In a bid to “look successful,” many young Indians are spending beyond their means—buying the latest iPhones on EMI, splurging on luxury brands, partying at expensive places, and chasing Instagram-worthy lifestyles. Social media fuels this pressure, where everyone feels the need to "flex" even if it's all on borrowed money.

This constant need to impress leads to debt, poor savings, and zero investments. Instead of building long-term financial stability, youth are trapped in a cycle of spending for validation. In the end, it’s not a rich life—they're just going broke trying to look rich.
